blockers.text: No bookmaker-quoted parlay price. No free data source returns a bookmaker's own price for a combination, so a parlay needs a quote recorded from that bookmaker's bet slip earlier today (New York time). A product of leg prices is never shown as a quote.

No validated joint-probability estimate. Multiplying leg probabilities assumes the legs are independent and each leg is well calibrated; the settled evidence does not yet meet the pre-registered criteria.

parlays.disclosure: Parlays are higher-variance and win less often than single picks. Any parlay shown here would be paper-traded research, never a guarantee.
